items.name: tokens
items.title: Tokens
items.description: The palette as a Tailwind stylesheet, emitted from the same source as the native one so the two cannot drift.
items.docs: Import the stylesheet from your app's CSS entry, after `@import "tailwindcss";` and before your own palette: `@import "../cubeui-tokens.css";` (the path is relative to that file; `cubeui-tokens.css` lands next to components.json). It brings `cubeui-reset.css`, the layout defaults every compiled component relies on, and `tw-animate-css` with it.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: The class merger every component calls, the one hover helper that has to be gated on platform, and the `webAs` declaration the RN→web compiler reads.

items.name: color
items.title: Color Helpers
items.description: Derives an accent and a desaturated tint from a user-chosen hex colour.

items.name: readable-text-color
items.title: Readable Text Color
items.description: Picks black or white ink for text sitting on a colour the user chose, by WCAG contrast.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The icon set, per-icon imports on native and a tree-shaken barrel on web, with the context that gives native icons a colour to inherit.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A Pressable-backed button whose variants split into container and text halves, because native inherits no text colour.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A card with typed text slots, an optional accent bar, and a whole-card press target that stays reachable by keyboard.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout: a tinted, bordered box with an icon, a title, a line under it and an optional action. `default`, `info`, `warning` or `destructive`; only `destructive` is announced as an `alert`, the rest as a polite `status`.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Radix on web, with its whole prop surface; a Pressable announced through role and aria-checked on device. Controlled or uncontrolled on both.

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: Monospaced inline code and blocks.

items.name: color-bar
items.title: Color Bar
items.description: The left-edge accent stripe a card wears, readable in both themes and labelled for anyone who cannot see it.

items.name: color-dot
items.title: Color Dot
items.description: A small swatch standing in for a colour-coded thing in a list.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text entry, with an optional icon at its start (`leading`) or an icon-sized control at its end (`trailing`). Keeps a real DOM input on web so time, number and min/max survive; a TextInput on device.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search input
items.description: A search box: Input with a Search icon inside at its start, type=search (a searchbox), named by `label` (default Search), and a named clear button while it holds text.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A caption for a control. Radix on web so clicking it focuses the control; plain text on native, where that association does not exist.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text entry. Keeps a real DOM textarea on web; a multiline TextInput on device.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal. Radix on web with its focus trap and scroll lock; a transparent native Modal with a dimmed backdrop and a centred card.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Radix anchored to its trigger on web; a centred native sheet on device, because anchoring is a pointer-era affordance.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A popover of actions: radix DropdownMenu on web (arrow keys, typeahead, focus back on the trigger); the popover's centred sheet with menu and menuitem roles on device. A row takes an icon, a label, a trailing node and a destructive colour, and the menu closes when one is chosen. Checkbox rows toggle and keep the menu open; radio rows in a group choose one and close it.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A radix listbox under its trigger on web; the options in a Modal sheet on device, which is what every native platform does.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Radix on web; a Pressable track with a moving thumb on device, rather than RN's Switch, whose raw colour props would not follow the theme.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Radix on web; a row of Pressables over a context on device. Controlled (value/onValueChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue) on both. A trigger can carry an icon beside its label, in the tab's active or inactive colour.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Radix on hover and focus on web; long-press on device, which is the platform's own way to ask what a control does.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: An exclusive choice, one source for both platforms: `row` (circle, label, description), `card` (a tile with an icon) or `segmented` (a full-width framed row, icon-only segments allowed), with one tab stop and arrow keys that move and select handled inside.

items.name: radio-group-field
items.title: Radio Group Field
items.description: A set of exclusive choices bound to a TanStack form field, the options on the page and each able to carry a line saying what it means. The group is named by its title through aria-labelledby.

items.name: theme-picker
items.title: Theme Picker
items.description: Light, Dark and System as radio tiles, or with variant="compact" as a full-width row of icon-only radios for a sidebar or header, and useThemePreference(), which stores the choice and applies it: a class on <html> on the web, Appearance.setColorScheme on device, where the app passes its own storage. THEME_PRE_PAINT_SCRIPT is the inline <script> that paints the stored theme before React mounts.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A heading over a group of fields or rows: title, description, an action at the far end, an optional rule and an optional card surface. The title is a heading of rank `level` (2 by default), so a long settings page is navigable.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: One row of a list: `leading` (an avatar, a checkbox), a truncating `title` over a `description`, `meta` and `action` at the far end. With `onPress` the middle is one button and `leading` and `action` stay separate controls beside it, never nested in it.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: A titled part of a screen whose body shows and hides: "Show completed (3)", "Raw output". The header is one button with a turning chevron and `aria-expanded`, an optional `action` sits beside it rather than inside it, and `content` is mounted only while open. Uncontrolled with `defaultOpen`, or controlled with `open`/`onOpenChange`.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Read-only facts: `DescriptionList` over `PropertyRow`s, each a label, a value, an optional hint under the value and an optional action beside it. A `<dl>` of `<dt>`/`<dd>` groups on the web, `role="list"` on device; `layout="inline"` puts labels beside values and wraps to stacked when narrow.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: Stat Tile
items.description: One number on a card: a `label`, a large tabular `value`, an optional `hint` under it and an `icon` before the label. Given `onPress` the tile is a button, and with `selected` a toggle (`aria-pressed`) for the filter tile over a list. `loading` holds the figure's place.

items.name: section-heading
items.title: Section Heading
items.description: The small muted heading above a section of content, with an optional heading `level`.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: A segmented control: the pill, the named row it sits in (which can hold the current value), and the two class helpers a router link needs instead.

items.name: toggle-chip
items.title: Toggle Chip
items.description: A small on/off pill — a filter chip, a day toggle, a swatch — with its colour split across container and label.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A horizontal bar showing how much of something is done: `role="progressbar"` with its value announced, `value` from 0 to `max` (100 by default) as shadcn's, clamped. `label` names it; `valueLabel` reads the value in words.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A pill naming what something is or what state it is in — and, with no label, the dot that says the same thing in a tighter row. `onRemove` adds a trailing ✕ for a tag the user can take off.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: An icon button that copies `value` to the clipboard and turns into a tick for a moment, named `Copy` (or `label`) and then `Copied`.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A loading indicator: the LoaderCircle glyph turning, one `role="status"` named by `label`, sized and coloured by `className`.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, description and error chrome around a control. The unbound half of the form set.

items.name: switch-field
items.title: Switch Field
items.description: A switch and its caption on one row, with the whole row in the hit target on both platforms.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: A destructive-action confirmation dialog: Cancel plus one destructive button.

items.name: confirm
items.title: Confirm
items.description: One confirmation prompt for both platforms, as a promise: `if (await confirm({…})) remove()`.

items.name: form-element
items.title: Form Element
items.description: A real `<form>` on web so Enter submits; a `View` on native, where nothing raises a submit event.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Fields bound to TanStack Form: label, control and error wired once, for both platforms. `useAppForm`, the text, select, checkbox and switch fields, `SubmitButton`, and `bindToForm` for the rest.

items.name: form-dialog
items.title: Form Dialog
items.description: Dialog chrome for a form, with a footer that leaves the submit control to the caller.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient messages for mutations fired outside a form — the failures that otherwise reach only the console.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month of single-date selection: react-day-picker on web, a date-fns grid on device.

items.name: date-time-input
items.title: Date Time Input
items.description: A date popover and a time field that commit one Date back — or, with `clearable mode="date"`, an optional date only.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Swatches plus a hex field, replacing `<input type="color">` — which has no native counterpart.

items.name: date-time-field
items.title: Date Time Field
items.description: `DateTimeInput` bound to a `Date | null` form field, named by its label and its date: "Due September 15th, 2026". Its own item for the weight of the calendar.

items.name: color-picker-field
items.title: Color Picker Field
items.description: `ColorPicker` bound to a hex-string form field, its swatch row named by the field's label. `ColorField`, under an item name that does not collide with the web-only `color-field`.

items.name: file-picker
items.title: File Picker
items.description: A drop zone, or a button, over a hidden file input on web. The native half is a placeholder, not an implementation.

items.name: inline-number-edit
items.title: Inline Number Edit
items.description: A number shown as text, becoming an input when pressed. Commits on blur and on submit.

items.name: inline-text-edit
items.title: Inline Text Edit
items.description: A line of text, or a heading, that becomes an input when edited — a rename. Commits on blur and on submit, Escape cancels, and an empty or unchanged draft is not saved.

items.name: query-state
items.title: Query State
items.description: The three rungs a list of rows climbs before it is a list of rows — failed, pending, empty — with the error card and the row placeholders exported on their own.

items.name: page
items.title: Page
items.description: The page shell, its header, the card grid and the empty state — the four pieces every route repeats.

items.name: detail-page
items.title: Detail Page
items.description: The page shell plus a loading / not-found guard that narrows the entity for its children.

items.name: detail-header
items.title: Detail Header
items.description: The header row of a detail view: back, colour dot, title, badge, subtitle, actions.

items.name: route-error
items.title: Route Error
items.description: What shows when the tree below a route has thrown, with nothing in it that could have been the cause. The whole error boundary in one element: an alert with a title, a friendly line, an optional copyable raw message (`details`) and extra buttons beside Try again (`actions`).

items.name: header-content-footer
items.title: Header / Content / Footer
items.description: The page chassis: chrome that stays, a body that scrolls, floors that let it. Ships the sticky preset alongside the base.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The title block a page wears in a header slot: an optional trail, an icon and title at a chosen heading level, a description, the page's buttons at the far end, and a search or filter row beneath. Carries the inset the page chassis leaves it.

items.name: page-layout
items.title: Page Layout
items.description: A whole page: a PageHeader pinned above a body that scrolls under it, in a named column.

items.name: split-layout
items.title: Split Layout
items.description: Two panes side by side on a named width scale, with the floors that keep one wide child from pushing the other off the screen. Ships SidebarLayout, the preset for the common case where one pane is the screen and the other is beside it.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app's sidebar: a header, a body that scrolls and a footer on the sidebar palette at a fixed width, with an optional titled list of rows and the nav row itself — a link with an icon, a truncating label, a count and aria-current on the active page.

items.name: card-layout
items.title: Card Layout
items.description: A card with its slots already placed: icon, title, description, header action, body, and a footer split between prose and buttons.

items.name: dialog-layout
items.title: Dialog Layout
items.description: A dialog whose body scrolls under a header that does not, and which asks before closing on unsaved work. Composes the header/content/footer chassis rather than owning a second copy.

items.name: skill
items.title: cubeui Agent Skill
items.description: How to use these components, for agents working in a consuming project. Installs into .claude/skills/ as a router plus layout, form and control references, and says which half of the registry — DOM or React Native — the project is on.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action Button
items.description: An icon button with a required accessible name, and a tooltip that survives being disabled. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: shadcn's modal that interrupts to ask, re-published from here so it imports the same `cn` every other file in the install does. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: app-form
items.title: App Form
items.description: The TanStack Form binding: useAppForm, plus one-element fields — InputField, TextareaField, SelectField, CheckboxField, SwitchField — that take the form and a checked field name instead of a render prop, and SubmitButton. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: color-field
items.title: Color Field
items.description: A colour picker as one line, over a field the compiler checked holds a string. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: shadcn's command palette, re-published from here so it imports the same `cn` every other file in the install does. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: A destructive button that asks first, with a required description of what is lost. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: control
items.title: Control Set
items.description: Every cubeui control in one install. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date Field
items.description: A date and a date range as one line each, over fields the compiler checked hold a Date and a DateRange. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date and optionally a time behind a popover, plus a range picker that closes when the range is complete. Clearing is a real button, not one nested in another. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: disclosure-row
items.title: Disclosure Row
items.description: A list row that opens: the whole heading is the button, the actions sit outside it, and the body is Item's footer. Built on the same Item every other row in the list is. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: shadcn's empty state, re-published from here so the voice every project uses for "there is nothing yet" is edited in one place. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: field-row
items.title: Field Row
items.description: Fields side by side on one row, wrapping when they no longer fit rather than squeezing to a width the values no longer read at. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: One field: a label wired to its control, a description that sits inline or behind a help icon, an error the control is described by, and a skeleton the right height for what is loading. Presentational, so the TanStack binding sits on it rather than beside it. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: form-set
items.title: Form Set
items.description: Every cubeui form component in one install, TanStack binding included. Named `form-set` rather than `form`: that name is the React Native `Form` component in this registry, and the shadcn CLI resolves a cross-item import by basename, so the two cannot share it. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: shadcn's list row, re-published from here so the row shared by every list in every project is edited in one place. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout Set
items.description: Every cubeui layout shell in one install. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: A combobox that selects more than one thing: portalled, keyboard-operable, searchable on every word, with an optional create row and coloured chips. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: multi-select-field
items.title: Multi Select Field
items.description: The multi-select as one line of a form, over a field the compiler checked holds a list of strings. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: option-select
items.title: OptionSelect
items.description: A select taking its choices as options rather than seven primitives to assemble, with groups and separators, and the id and aria props landing on the trigger where Radix needs them. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password Field
items.description: A password as one line, with a reveal button none of the nine hand-written password inputs has. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password box with a reveal button that is named, changes its name, and does not submit the form. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: primitive
items.title: Vendored Primitives
items.description: The shadcn primitives cubeui re-publishes unchanged, so a change made here reaches every project. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: shadcn's rule, re-published from here so it imports the same `cn` every other file in the install does. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: shadcn's loading placeholder, re-published from here so it imports the same `cn` every other file in the install does. Web-only: no React Native half.

items.name: badge-stories
items.title: Badge stories
items.description: Storybook stories for @cubeui/badge, installed beside it so they render under your own stylesheet and run as tests under addon-vitest. Needs Storybook 9 or later on @storybook/react-vite.
